annotations.evidence: Jastrow's text names `אִסְטְרַטְיָא I`: A02560 `= אִסְטְרַטְיָא I, camp, station`; O01590 `(= אִסְטְרַטְיָא I) camp, station` (maintainer scan read of each cite, 2026-10-27, C1 re-read). The line, as Sefaria transcribes it, sets its only `I` after `אִיסְ׳`, which by ruling 10-05 numbers that form's consonant sequence, not `אִסְטְרַטְיָא`'s. Head line read by the maintainer on the scan, 2026-10-27 (91b · leaf 114): print sets I only after `אִיסְ׳`, none beside the first form

senses.gloss: f. (στρατεία, in the sense of στρατόπεδον) camp, encampment, esp. an open space infront of the royal palace, court; also station on the road for Temple pilgrims.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 26a:9">Erub. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ של מלכים</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מלך</he>) camp or court round the royal palace. [<cite ref="Menachot 103b:20">Men. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>איסטריא של מלך</he>, for <he>איסטרטיא</he>(?), v. however <cite ref="A02422"><he>אִסְטַרְיָא</he></cite>.] [<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3">Lam. R. to III, 7</cite> <he>באידנא א׳</he>; Ab. d’R. Nath. XXVIlI <he>לאי׳</he>, read <cite ref="A02408"><he>אִסְטְרָטָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 20:19">Targ. Y. Num. XX, 19</cite> <he>רַטְיָא …</he> some ed., v. <cite ref="A02408"><he>אִסְטְרָטָא</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>אִסְטְרַטְיָאוֹת</he>.
